about.title: About Kent Sri Lankan Social Club
about.subtitle: A community-led organisation dedicated to bringing together Sri Lankan families and friends across Kent and in the United Kingdom. We celebrate our heritage, support one another, and build bridges across generations.
about.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide everything we do as a club.

heritage.title: Heritage
heritage.description: Honouring and preserving Sri Lankan traditions for future generations.

culture.title: Culture
culture.description: Celebrating the arts, customs, and spirit that make our community unique.

unity.title: Unity
unity.description: Bringing families and friends together across every background and generation.

about.visionText: To be the leading platform for Sri Lankan cultural preservation and community integration in Kent, enriching lives and strengthening intergenerational bonds for years to come.
about.missionText: To foster a vibrant and inclusive community hub for Sri Lankans residing in Kent, promoting social interaction, cultural exchange, and mutual support through regular gatherings and diverse events.

beginning.title: The Beginning
beginning.description: A small group of Sri Lankan families in Kent came together to celebrate culture, share traditions, and plant the seed for a thriving community.

formed.title: Officially Formed
formed.description: Kent Sri Lankan Social Club was formally established with a mission to preserve heritage, support families, and build lasting friendships across the county.

digital.title: Digital Platform Launched
digital.description: Launched our digital home to connect members, promote local Sri Lankan businesses, and make events accessible to everyone in Kent.

ahead.title: Looking Ahead
ahead.description: Expanding youth programmes, supporting Sri Lankan entrepreneurs, growing our membership, and creating even more ways to celebrate our heritage together.

about.committeeSubtitle: Our volunteer committee works year-round to keep the club running.

privacy.metaTitle: Privacy Policy | Kent Sri Lankan Social Club
privacy.metaDescription: How the Kent Sri Lankan Social Club collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.text: Kent Sri Lankan Social Club ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use our website and services.

dataController.title: 2. Data Controller
dataController.text: The data controller is Kent Sri Lankan Social Club. If you have any questions about this policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at

accountData.label: Account data
accountData.text: name, email address, phone number, and address when you register or become a member.

membershipData.label: Membership data
membershipData.text: membership type, status, dependants, and payment information handled by our payment processor.

eventData.label: Event data
eventData.text: ticket purchases, attendance, and related communications.

contactData.label: Contact data
contactData.text: messages you send through our contact form.

technicalData.label: Technical data
technicalData.text: IP address, browser type, and cookies for analytics and security.

howWeUse.title: 4. How We Use Your Data
howWeUse.membership: To provide membership, events, ticketing, and fundraising services.
howWeUse.communications: To communicate with you about club news, events, and updates.
howWeUse.enquiries: To respond to your enquiries and improve our services.
howWeUse.legal: To comply with legal and regulatory obligations.

legalBasis.title: 5. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.text: We process your personal data on the basis of your consent, the necessity to perform a contract with you, compliance with legal obligations, or our legitimate interests in operating the club.

sharing.title: 6. Sharing Your Data
sharing.text: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with trusted service providers (such as payment processors, email services, and hosting providers) only to the extent necessary to deliver our services.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
retention.text: We keep your data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by law. Soft-deleted records are retained for audit purposes and removed in line with our retention schedule.

yourRights.title: 8. Your Rights
yourRights.text: Under the UK GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, erase, restrict, or object to the processing of your personal data, and the right to data portability. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at

cookies.title: 9. Cookies
cookies.text: We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the website, remember your preferences, and analyse traffic. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
